cohort: The study included 89 term singleton stillbirth babies whose placentas were examined in the labor ward.
finding: The study provides essential insights into the placental findings associated with term singleton stillbirths, suggesting that placental examination can help define causes in over 90% of stillbirth cases.
cross-section timing: At the time of stillbirth delivery in the labor ward
birth_weight: Variable measured, but no specific range for all babies is provided.
